claim_text: Aggregated coverage on 16 August 2026 reported that the body of a teenager missing in Delaware County floodwaters had been recovered, described in one outlet's headline as the fourth death attributed to the week's severe weather in Indiana.
quote: Teen's body found in Delaware County is 4th death due to week's severe weather
confidence_justification: Headline-level only; the recovery is corroborated by the Delaware County Sheriff's Office statements in other cluster articles, but the ordinal 'fourth' conflicts with later state counts.
